information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LopesUpAZ2026#69727-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

#### This competition is FREE for GCU students!  Please email the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact/website?competitionId=LopesUpAZ2026) a photo of your student ID and we will manually accept your registration (do not pay the registration fee, please).

## This competition is hosted by the GCU Cubing Club
